candidates.description: This vector represents lowercase and uppercase letters of the Greek alphabet.
This vector represents interrogative and relative conjunction words across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of scale, importance, and magnitude across multiple languages.
This vector activates on adjectives and prefixes describing historical, political, or cultural movements, eras, and ideologies.
The feature represents a collection of common syllable fragments and morphophonemic roots characteristic of Turkic languages.
This vector represents adverbial suffixes and adverbial modifiers across multiple languages.
This vector represents grammatical gender and proper names in various European languages.
This feature activates on lowercase, uppercase, and subword tokens that commonly appear in Italian names and vocabulary.
This vector represents common Spanish verbs and verb suffixes, particularly associated with past tense and action words.
These tokens represent common Spanish nominal suffixes and root-ending patterns used to form abstract nouns and adverbs.
